experiences.name: Wachau Danube Valley
experiences.description: Melk to Krems along the north bank of the Danube through the Wachau: Spitz, the terraced apricot and wine slopes, and the cliffside village of Dürnstein. Short, flat and scenic, with plenty of stops for wine and cake.

experiences.name: Nockalm Road
experiences.description: From Bad Kleinkirchheim over the Nockalmstrasse, a toll road through the Nockberge with more than fifty bends and wide grassy summits, to Innerkrems and Rennweg. A purpose-built panorama road with smooth asphalt.

experiences.name: Arlberg and Paznaun to the Silvretta
experiences.description: From Bludenz over the Arlberg Pass to St. Anton, down the Stanzer valley and up the Paznaun valley through Ischgl and Galtür to the Bielerhöhe, the high pass beside the Silvretta reservoir. Valley sweepers, a classic alpine pass and a final climb to a glacier-fed lake at 2,000 m.

experiences.name: Gerlos Alpine Road
experiences.description: Zell am Ziller over the Gerlos Pass, past the Krimml waterfalls, and on to Mittersill. A fast, smooth road with long sweepers, perfect for a half-day ride.

sights.name: Pfarrkirche zu den Heiligen Laurentius und Bartholomäus

experiences.name: Carinthian Lakes
experiences.description: Klagenfurt along the Wörthersee to Velden, on to Villach and up the Ossiacher See. Warm lakes, villas and beach cafes, with no passes and no hurry.

sights.name: Pfarrkirche Sankt Niklas an der Drau

experiences.name: Grossglockner High Alpine Road
experiences.description: Salzburg through the Salzach valley to Zell am See, then the Grossglockner High Alpine Road over the Hochtor to Heiligenblut and down to Lienz. Austria's most famous motorcycle road, a toll road with 36 hairpins and views of the Pasterze glacier.

experiences.name: Kühtai and Timmelsjoch
experiences.description: Innsbruck over the Kühtai saddle into the Ötztal, up to Sölden and across the Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road to the Italian border. Two high Tyrolean passes and one of the most modern alpine roads in Europe.

experiences.name: Bregenzerwald to the Arlberg
experiences.description: From Bregenz on Lake Constance through the Bregenzerwald, over the Hochtannberg Pass to Lech, then the Flexen road past Zürs to St. Anton. A green valley road followed by big alpine scenery and the Flexen galleries.

experiences.name: Kitzbühel and Felbertauern
experiences.description: Kufstein, the Wilder Kaiser and Kitzbühel, over the Pass Thurn to Mittersill, then the Felbertauern road through the Hohe Tauern to Lienz. A scenic crossing from Tyrol to East Tyrol.

experiences.name: Salzkammergut Lakes Loop
experiences.description: A loop from Salzburg through Mondsee and Bad Ischl to Bad Goisern on Lake Hallstatt, then over the Pass Gschütt to Abtenau and back through the Salzach valley. Lakes, mountain villages and the Dachstein backdrop.

sights.name: Röm. Kath. Pfarrkirche zum Heiligen Blasius

experiences.name: Styrian Wine Road to Soboth
experiences.description: Graz through the South Styrian wine country around Gamlitz and Leutschach, over the Soboth Pass into Carinthia and down to Lavamünd, then on to Klagenfurt. Vineyard lanes first, then a quiet pass with almost no traffic.

sights.name: Schloss St. Georgen an der Stiefing

experiences.name: Neusiedler See
experiences.description: Vienna to the Neusiedler See via Eisenstadt and Rust, then around the north end of the lake to Podersdorf. A flat, easy ride through vineyards and reed beds with storks and wine taverns.

experiences.name: Gesäuse and Präbichl
experiences.description: From Schladming along the Enns valley to Admont, through the Gesäuse gorge to Hieflau, then Eisenerz and the Präbichl pass to Leoben. Mountain cliffs, the Erzberg mine and a classic Styrian pass.

sights.name: Pfarrkirche hl. Johannes der Täufer Ardning

experiences.name: Gailtal Valley
experiences.description: From Lienz over the Gailbergsattel into the Gailtal, through Kötschach and Hermagor to Villach. A quiet southern Alpine valley below the Carnic Alps, with almost no traffic.

experiences.name: Vienna Woods and Semmering
experiences.description: From Vienna through the Vienna Woods to Baden and Hohe Wand, around the Schneeberg to Puchberg, then the Semmering pass to Mürzzuschlag. A day trip from the city to the mountains the Viennese ride at weekends.

experiences.name: Hohe Tauern and Nockalm Grand Tour
experiences.description: Zell am See over the Grossglockner High Alpine Road to Heiligenblut, down the Möll valley and across to Bad Kleinkirchheim, then up the whole Nockalm Road and the Katschberg to Radstadt. Two of Austria's great panorama roads linked in one long day.

experiences.name: Vorarlberg to Timmelsjoch
experiences.description: Bregenz through the Bregenzerwald, over the Hochtannberg Pass and the Arlberg to St. Anton, then up the Ötztal to Sölden and the Timmelsjoch. West to south Tyrol in a single big day.

sights.name: Kapelle zu den Sieben Schmerzen Mariens
Kapelle Heilige Anna auf dem Felde

experiences.name: Danube Road from Engelhartszell to Vienna
experiences.description: The Danube from the Schlögen loop through Linz, Melk and the Wachau to Vienna. Riverside roads, abbeys and castles rather than mountains, and nearly all of it by the water.

experiences.name: Gerlos to Grossglockner
experiences.description: Innsbruck, over the Gerlos Pass to Krimml, via Zell am See and over the Grossglockner High Alpine Road to Heiligenblut and Lienz. Two of Austria's best-known roads in one day.

experiences.name: Vienna to Graz via Mariazell
experiences.description: Vienna over the Semmering to Mürzzuschlag and Mariazell, then the Seeberg saddle and Aflenz to Bruck an der Mur and Graz. A countryside route through the Styrian foothills instead of the motorway.

sights.name: Museum St. Peter an der Sperr
ehem. Zisterzienserabtei Neuberg an der Mürz
